verdict.rationale: AngelList documents an ASC 718 Analysis Report that uses a Black-Scholes model to give grant- and tranche-level breakdowns, and its cap table reports export to Excel, which covers the core of the story. However, the report is gated to the Scale Plan, and the equity FAQ says customers are being moved to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which casts doubt on ongoing availability. Missing for 10: confirmation the equity product and report are still offered, detail on audit-ready output (assumptions disclosure, journal entries, forfeiture handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration that auditors accept the reports.
